queries.item: ALTER TABLE ?:products ADD `allow_sg_quotation` CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y';
ALTER TABLE ?:products ADD `sg_quotation_note` text NOT NULL DEFAULT '';

CREATE TABLE `?:sg_quotations` ( `quotation_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` text NULL, `company_id` text NOT NULL, `price` decimal(11,2) NULL, `customer_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL default '', `customer_email` varchar(128) NOT NULL default '', `customer_phone` varchar(128) NOT NULL default '', `required_qty` text NULL, `note` text NULL, `created_at` text NULL, `approved_at` text NULL, `order_id` int(11) NULL, `order_placed_at` text NULL, `discounted_price` float NULL, `discount` float NULL, `discount_type` char(1) NULL, `disapproved_reason` text NULL, `approved_by` int(11) NULL, `status` char(11) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`quotation_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
